text: 还记得今年4月XPL那次闪崩么？当时猜测不少，还有人怀疑是Binance 操盘故意爆掉Hyper的HLP金库。 TradingBeats 团队追踪了近7个月的资金线，发现11月这次XPL闪崩，竟与4月那批可疑地址存在资金关联，甚至和之前Fartcoin闪崩的地址也有关联。一波人用同样一种操盘手法至少复刻了三次：换了钱包，先建巨额多单，暴跌前抽走保证金，留下仓位等爆仓，让HLP接盘，再在其他CEX上开对手盘，这样既能获得操盘收益，又能逃过中心化交易所的异常交易监测，防止账户被冻结，所以基本说明这是一个惯犯团队，并不属于某个交易所或者项目方，全文如下👇
author: Pxstar_
quoted_text:
5）故技重施，HLP 被迫接管 1200 万「弃子」多仓

16 地址集群抽离保证金，HLP 接管逾 1200 万美元多仓，本轮 XPL 闪崩发生于 11 月 1 日 12:32，当分钟价格从开盘至最低下跌约 18%

据 Quote 流动性供应商复盘，16 地址集群此前合计持有约 2309 万美元 XPL 多仓，其中 12 个地址在暴跌前集中提交并获准约 203.86 万美元提现请求

Hyperliquid 官方成交记录显示，HLP 清算金库在本轮事件中合计接管约 1217.7 万美元 XPL 多仓，涉及 30 个遭清算账户，其中 11 个属于上述集群。Quote 测算最终处置损失约 55.58 万美元

这类被称为「自杀式清算」的交易结构，通常表现为账户在保留大额多仓的同时，提前提走可提现保证金，压缩剩余仓位的清算缓冲

此类操作的潜在获利来源可能来自 CEX 现货与合约市场的配合。若相关账户同时在中心化交易所持有空头头寸，或通过现货交易参与价格波动，其跨市场收益可能覆盖 Hyperliquid 多仓的清算损失。尤其当大额仓位被动平仓加剧价格下跌时，其他市场的空头可能获得收益，而部分流动性不足的残余仓位风险则由 HLP 承接

okay Monday morning, US election week. 

Let me get this straight:

- grocery stores throughout Europe have had their fridges turned up to 100+ degrees by unknown hackers

- aka exactly what a sophisticated actor would do if they wanted to disrupt US east coast food supply next week

- US military bases already had essentially the same thing happen last week

- founder of Shopify tweets there’s a TCP vulnerability that basically makes every server on earth that’s not a managed service completely remotely controllable

- a nontechnical 26 year old hacked several major banks using only chatbots

- billions of dollars successfully stolen from different exchanges in several countries,  notably most of that was  $6.3b from binance in just 20 minutes. They’re “fine” per the CEO. Okay lol

- random civilian private jet crashes a few miles outside trumps house yesterday, right as Tucker Carlson of all people warns us Trump might be considering using nukes

- US Senator who warned about the same thing recently “had a stroke” over the weekend, alright sure

- bibi lost his majority so his only chance to stay in power is for a new war to begin

- Poland currently in constitutional crisis/coup, both it and Lithuania just sent troops to the border w/Russia. NATO did the same in Latvia. Turkey moved fighter jets to the border too.

- Germany’s leaders phones all hacked

- openai and Anthropic are going to release gpt-6.2 and fable 5.5 after elections this week because somehow more capable models will help? lol no

- many streets in downtown DC is shut down right now for a speech today outside the Lincoln memorial?

- DOJ trying to pull ballots in California 

- documentaries openly critical of Elon & Zuck are BOTH pulled from theaters in just weeks because nobody knew about them and went to saw them. Not suspicious at all.

- oh and Russia and Ukraine both had their nuclear alerts hacked and sent false alerts of “impending air raids, chemical, and nuclear attacks” what could go wrong!

Unbelievably, there is not a hint of any of this on my Facebook, insta, tiktok, reddit, threads, blue sky, or LinkedIn feeds. You can ask any ai except chat about it and it goes, no yeah that’s about right. ChatGPT goes “you’re not allowed to ask about this”

I can’t decide if that’s a very good thing and we finally figured out the emotional and psychological dangers of social media algorithms (except elon 🙄) OR it’s actually really bad people are voting in the dark

What a strange moment in time. And I’m supposed to send emails today?! For sure

author: bliquidc
quoted_text:
1. Bitcoin has proven demand for digital rocks 
2. ZEC has proven demand for hedging some of BTC tail risk
3. Pearl might prove that running on a 10x larger infrastructure substrate than Bitcoin (btc mining is 10-15 GW globally, AI data centers are 150 GW) makes it a better alternative digital rock than ZEC

The reason you take the bet now is that it is before the hard fork going live this quarter that will put that theory to test. To date pearl mining has been on training wheels / like any other PoW coin before because it hasn’t been compatible with the primary models people are using; FP8 hardfork changes that. Being able to mine pearl and serve inference breaks the “hash rate follows price” doom loop that has haunted non-BTC PoW coins to date.

And with supply, its impact on price is ultimately a function of whether demand growth outstrips it or not. I think Pearl gets more than 2x interesting over the next year. I bought my position because I had no answer for “What happens if this things hits 10/15/25/50% of BTC electricity footprint”.

text:
上海复兴公园一家夜店靠 288 元通票，一年营收做到 1.5 亿美元
彭博商业周刊（Bloomberg Businessweek）刚发了一篇深度特写，主角是上海复兴公园里的七层夜生活综合体 INS 新乐园（INS Land）。
白天，复兴公园里满是晨跑、打牌和跳广场舞的退休老人。到了晚上，成群结队的二十多岁年轻人涌进同一座公园里的七层大楼，一直蹦到天亮，在清晨和晨练的大爷大妈擦肩而过。
这栋楼里塞下了 20 家门店和 9 家不同风格的夜店，除了 DJ 演出和舞台秀，还配了水烟吧、碰碰车、面馆，甚至内置了一个类似 Tinder 的现场实时配对小程序。NBA 球星哈登和王嘉尔也去打过卡。
【288 元通票改写传统夜店规则】
过去国内夜店的传统玩法，核心是男性主导的“开卡炫富”——靠昂贵的洋酒套餐和 VIP 卡座撑场面。
INS（全称 Into Nothing Serious）直接改了这套规则，推出了 288 元（约 43 美元）的一票通。买一张手环，就能进出整栋楼里所有的夜店，而且每家店还送一杯免费酒水。在年轻人消费降级、追求性价比的当下，这种“成人版迪士尼”模式把门槛拉了下来：工作日客流高达 1 万人次，周末直接翻倍到 2 万人次，一年营收干到了 1.5 亿美元（约合 10.8 亿人民币）。
【凌晨四点的牛腩面与连蹦六晚的大学生】
20 岁的艺术系大四学生 Wang Zilin 从 2023 年开业起就是这里的常客。他在里面约过会、凌晨 4 点和陌生人拼桌吃路边摊，还破解过自动啤酒机的密码。他最猛的一次连续在里面泡了六个通宵，天天无视宿舍门禁，直到最后咳血才停下来。
回忆起第一次去 INS 的场景，他说：“所有人都告诉我这是全亚洲最牛的夜店。我当时感觉自己像去麦加朝圣的信徒，就想亲眼看看这个巨大的立方体。那种感觉很难形容，太震撼了。”
蹦累了的年轻人会下到一楼，吃口斑斓椰子恰巴塔或者牛腩面回血。大楼外的公厕里甚至还配了扫码免费领计生用品的机器。在海外社交媒体上，这里已经被外国游客列为和上海迪士尼并列的必打卡景点。

text:
🧐31 岁的 Jeff Yan ，他把 Hyperliquid 当成「承载交易所的基础设施」

笔者 @RyanJamesWeeks  专程前往华盛顿特区，与 Jeff Yan  @chameleon_jeff 交流，了解他一手打造、发展迅猛的加密平台 Hyperliquid 的后续战略规划。

我们在庄重的 Riggs 酒店一楼咖啡馆落座，他的安保人员在不远处保持警戒。交谈中我发现，这位 31 岁的创始人，未必会给出直白确定的答案。

这位估值达十亿美元级别的程序员，深谙加密行业的表述逻辑。外界普遍将 Hyperliquid 定义为数字资产交易所，但他始终强调，Hyperliquid 本身不是交易所，而是「承载交易所的底层基础设施层」。

他将其类比为互联网：在 Hyperliquid 之上搭建应用的开发者，需要自行设计风控与制衡机制。Jeff Yan 不愿空谈行业远景，更专注于代码研发。「我几乎所有时间都投入工作，」他说，「对我而言，工作占据了全部精力。」

这份投入带来了显著成果：Hyperliquid 最初只是一个离岸小众平台，主打永续合约（Perps），也就是全天候连续交易、无到期日的合约。如今它已经成长为核心交易市场，支持股票、黄金等各类资产的代理合约交易，平台过去 12 个月营收 7.13 亿美元。

Hyperliquid 于 2023 年上线，尽管并未面向美国市场开放，它的增长势头已经震动包括全球最大衍生品交易所 CME Group 在内的行业头部机构，也引起了白宫的关注。

Donald Trump 是加密行业支持者，去年通过自身加密项目获得超 14 亿美元收益，他曾表示监管机构正全力研究永续合约的监管框架。

Jeff Yan 常驻新加坡，本次到访华盛顿，为 Hyperliquid Policy Center 提供支持。该机构是独立游说主体，持续向美国监管机构提交文件，阐释平台的价值。

*图片来源：Greg Kahn，《彭博商业周刊》

text:
为什么黑客能攻破币安、Bybit、Bitget，却始终动不了 Coinbase？🧵👇

封存 95.9 万枚比特币，价值高达 1033.1 亿美元，安稳存放 14 年从未出事。

1、不做巨型蜜罐：6980 万个独立用户存款地址

大部分交易所为了快速提币，会把数十亿资金集中归集在少数几个热钱包里。
一旦黑客攻破运维权限，就能一锅端走全部资产。

Coinbase 的逻辑完全不同。它采用 MPC 多方安全计算，不存在完整私钥，私钥全程被拆分成碎片，分散储存在独立硬件芯片中。

6980 万个地址，并不是 Coinbase 储存自有资金的钱包，而是给用户单独分配的专属存款地址。
Coinbase 的真实资金，依旧统一存放于官方热钱包、冷钱包体系中。

但这套机制依然无解安全：
2026 年 10 月黑客攻破币安运维电脑，劫持热钱包签名权限，20 分钟盗走 63.6 亿美金。

可在 Coinbase，就算黑客入侵员工电脑，拿到的只是零碎、无效的密钥分片，根本没法签名转走资产。

text:
How I made $16,000+ on Meteora LP in 17 days

This is fee scalping, not holding
Here's the exact strategy, straight from on chain data

Wallet 1 of my 30 → 500 SOL challenge
(797 positions, 53s median hold):

The numbers:
- Net PnL: +188.96 SOL (Fees: +415.88 SOL)
- Win rate: 84% (Avg size: 20.8 SOL)
- Profit factor: 1.92 | Max DD: -25.9 SOL | 15/18 green days

The setup:
- Fresh memecoins vs SOL (bin step 100, 1-3% base fee)
- 96% Spot shape, wide ranges (1/3 near the 70-bin max)
- Max 3 active positions at a time
- 91% of trades closed under 5 mins (~7 re-entries per pool while volume is hot)

One-sided vs Two-sided:
- One-sided SOL (68% of trades): 28s median hold, 42 bins avg. +55.9 SOL, 3.0 PF (profit factor). Cleanest setup with minimal downside.
- Two-sided (32%): re-opening the same pool with leftover tokens (~24% token), 2.3m hold. Brought in 71% of all fees (+80 SOL), but avg loss is 2x avg win due to token risk.

What actually worked best:
- 1-3 min hold time: 81% WR (win rate), 2.7 PF (profit factor)
- Wide 61-70 bin ranges crushed tight ≤20 bin ranges (3.66 PF vs 1.19 PF)
- Bin step ≤80 pools printed 7-9 PF
- 5% fee pools lost money

text:
BitMEX 创始人 Arthur Hayes 亲自下场做 AI 挖矿？今天 FLOP Devnet 正式向开发者开放了！🧪

蹲了好久的AI挖矿项目 @flop_labs 的公告，FLOP Devnet 现在向开发者开放，支持获取测试 FLOP、浏览区块、调用 AI 模型，以及通过 API、MCP 和 SDK 接入 Agent。

 FLOP 背后的团队。

FLOP Labs 的 CEO 是 Arthur Hayes（@CryptoHayes）。

可能有些兄弟对这个名字不陌生，他是 BitMEX 联合创始人，也是 Maelstrom 的首席投资官。

2026 年 8 月，Hayes 公开宣布重新回到一线经营岗位，出任 FLOP Labs CEO。

根据项目团队资料及公开报道，核心成员还包括：

Arthur Hayes： 创始人兼 CEO，BitMEX 联合创始人。
Sergey Vidyuk： CTO，曾在德意志银行和 BitMEX 从事技术架构与基础设施工作。
Shu Duan： 首席战略官（CSO），负责项目战略方向。

团队规模并不大，公开资料显示早期核心运营团队只有三个人。

项目网站还明确强调三个原则：不预售、不设置 VC 代币份额、100% 公平启动。

那么 FLOP 究竟想做什么？

简单理解，它想让 AI Agent 可以直接花钱购买算力，而拥有 GPU 的矿工可以通过提供真实的 AI 推理服务获得报酬。

传统 PoW 挖矿主要依靠计算哈希争夺出块权。

FLOP 则尝试走另一条路线：Proof of Useful Inference（PoUI），也就是有用推理证明。

它希望矿工不只是为了挖矿而计算，而是真正运行 AI 模型，完成 Agent 发来的推理任务，并提供可验证的计算证据。

整个逻辑可以理解成：

AI Agent 发起推理需求 → GPU 矿工执行任务 → 网络验证推理证据 → 完成支付结算 → 矿工获得经济激励。

我觉得这里最有意思的一点，是 FLOP 不只是提出一个 AI + PoW 的概念。

他们已经公开了 Yellow Paper、开发者 SDK、MCP 接口、API，以及矿工和验证者的部署文档。

GitHub 上还能看到 TechnoCore Chat、TCLK 等 Agent 协作和交易相关项目。

这些东西至少说明，团队正在围绕 AI Agent 的协作、支付、推理与验证建立一套基础设施。

今天开放的 Devnet 能做什么？

🧪 领取测试 FLOP，熟悉网络操作

🔍 通过区块浏览器查看链上数据

🤖 通过 API 调用模型、探索可验证推理

🔌 通过 MCP 将 FLOP 接入 Agent 工作流

💻 使用 SDK 开发应用，测试钱包与链上交互

⛏️ GPU 矿工和验证者也有对应的部署文档，不过具体接入权限和运行条件仍需查看官方要求。

相关入口我放在下面：

官网：https://t.co/egD7e3S2bM

浏览器：https://t.co/ZPXY4MAwxu

水龙头：https://t.co/TMCaENPyig

API：https://t.co/kr2Jei5hVK

MCP：https://t.co/SaEKQdXFcB

开发文档：https://t.co/8bmHkQFEnj

GitHub：https://t.co/itaUw4DOEF

SDK：npm i @flop-labs/sdk

最后还有几点需要特别注意。

目前并没有正式发行的 FLOP 代币，市面上任何所谓 FLOP 现货或预售都不能当作官方资产。
Devnet 测试 FLOP 没有经济价值，也不计入空投资格或权重。
Devnet 可能重置，今天的测试余额不代表未来的主网资产。
官方将主网与 TGE 的目标时间放在 2027 年第一季度，但具体进度仍可能调整。

我个人觉得，FLOP 值得研究的不是所谓的空投预期，而是它能否真正让 GPU 挖矿从单纯的计算竞争，转向为 AI Agent 提供有实际需求的推理服务。

如果这套验证和结算机制最终能在真实环境中跑通，那么 AI Agent 未来或许真的可以形成一个独立的算力经济网络。

当然，现在仍然是早期开发阶段，网络稳定性、推理验证能力以及实际需求都还需要时间检验。

接下来我会继续关注 FLOP 的技术进展，尤其是矿工部署、PoUI 验证以及 Agent 接入这三个方向。

矿工兄弟们开始备战：https://t.co/RDMAkRzphA

UPEG 团队又发了一个新项目：oolong 乌龙，隐隐感觉深谙中文的精髓。

oolong 部署在 Robinhood Chain，主打最高 1000 倍杠杆的链上永续合约。用户交易亏损后可以获得 OOLONG，LP 和代币持有者则围绕手续费与资金池收益建立激励。这套机制 copy Papertrade，可以概括为“亏损挖矿”。

两者的区别在于，PAPER 目前不能自由转账和出售，只能质押赚取 USDC。OOLONG 已经在 Uniswap V4 上交易，因此同时具备协议代币和 Meme 币的炒作属性。

链上信息也确认了 Oolong 与 UPEG 的关系。OOLONG 的部署钱包，与 UPEG 合约记录的 owner 地址一致，团队关联证据较强。

很多人关心一个问题：

Oolong 会给 UPEG 赋能吗？

目前答案是，没有明确的代币赋能。

现阶段没有看到 oolong 收入回购 UPEG、UPEG 质押分成、持币空投、手续费导流或跨链兑换机制。UPEG 在以太坊，OOLONG 在 Robinhood Chain，两者暂时没有公开的链上经济连接。

oolong 对 UPEG 的影响主要停留在叙事层面：

1. 新产品可以给 UPEG 带来更多关注

币安 .ai Agent ID 有了个新用处：AGC，一个只有带 Agent ID 的钱包才能挖的币。

我今天试了「免费挖」：
· 押 0.01 BNB 挖 5 份，24 小时后全额退回
· 同时到账 140 万 AGC（按今天下午价格约 $12）
· 不收手续费，不用给代币授权
· 每个 Agent ID 每天有额度：5、5、4、3 份，之后每天 1 份

几句实话：
· 第三方项目，跟币安没关系，币本身没有任何用途
· 今天下午 6 小时跌了近 40%，挖到的人都在卖，到手价值大概率继续缩
· 每挖 15 万份奖励减半，照现在的速度第 1 轮两天内挖完

text:
Not all ERC20 blacklist implementations are equal when it comes to asset recovery after an exploit.

Comparing USDT vs. USDC for example, the difference in how the smart contract is written resulted in an extra $200m+ USDT frozen in the Binance hack.

USDT only checks the sender, not the recipient: a blacklisted address can still receive USDT but can’t move it out. It’s just a honeypot.

USDC also checks the recipient: a hacker can’t receive USDC once blacklisted.

In the Binance hack, Tether blacklisted the hacker at 09:01:35 PM (UTC).
09:04:23 PM, the hacker transfers another $4m in.
09:44:11 PM, the hacker sends another $200m in.

Both transactions went through, delivering USDT into a honeypot where it was automatically frozen.

With an implementation similar to USDC, the transfers would have failed, leaving the hacker free to move those $204m to another address.

As more projects consider adding blacklisting to their ERC20 tokens, imo they should only check senders, not recipients.

text:
We’re bullish on tokenized stocks because moving equities onchain doesn’t just mirror its value, it unlocks entirely new ways to deploy the capital beneath them.

At @paboxoxyz, that begins with borrowing against stock tokens: tap liquidity without giving up exposure to the underlying stock, with real interest and liquidation risk, plus off‑market mechanics designed from zero specifically for tokenized equities.

It’s awesome and genuinely fun, but we know it’s not enough.

So we’re pushing into the next edge: using liquidity provider (LP) positions as collateral via @Uniswap v4 Hooks.

The setup is hard to ignore. As of writing, there’s already $161M+ in LP positions tied to tokenized stocks, yet composability is still missing.

An LP market could make this possible.

A liquidity provider could borrow against their position without pulling it from the pool, keeping their shot at earning trading fees while unlocking capital at the same time.

But we’re not rushing it.

Doing this right takes more than slapping a price tag on an LP token: the asset mix shifts, fees can underperform, and stock‑market closures make valuation messy, exactly the problems we’re working through.

This is the exploration we’re most excited about.

Our thesis is straightforward: tokenized stocks aren’t just “single stock” assets. Whatever form they evolve into becomes far more powerful once it can plug into trading, liquidity provision, and credit.

We’re building in that direction.

--

P.S.: Paboxo doesn’t have a token yet, and we’ll be partnering with @Moshdottrade to launch one in the future.

我觉得，Ignix 这次值得讨论的，不只是“持币又多了一种获得 BEM 的方式”。

而是它试图改变交易税的去向。

按照公布的设计，一部分交易税汇入共享矿场，用于购买符合条件的官方 BEM 矿机，再将实际挖矿产出按持有权重分配。

这让一笔原本容易停留在项目账户里的资金，有机会对应到具体的矿机资产和后续产出。

但交易税不是免费的原料，它首先是交易者承担的成本。

所以，评价这套机制，不能只看税收了多少，更要看：实际买到了什么、购入价格是否合理、矿机运行怎样、扣除相关成本后到底分配了多少。

真正有价值的变化，不是多讲了一层收益故事，而是资金用途开始有机会被连续追踪。

对 TapeOut 而言，这也提供了一种值得观察的连接：外部社区的交易活动，可以形成对矿机的需求；矿机的运行结果，又可能让这些社区更深入地理解 BEM。

不过，矿机买盘不等于 BEM 现货买盘，分配资格也不等于拥有矿机本身。不同层面的需求，应该分别看清楚。

我支持这样的探索，也期待后续用实际采购、运行和分配记录，让机制比宣传更有说服力。

一个生态真正开始向外延伸，不只是更多人听说它，而是其他产品开始找到使用它的理由。

Dün Amerika’da düşen uçakta hayatını kaybeden kişilerden birisi Adam Robinson.
Mezun olunca Wall Street’e giriyor. Lehman Brothers ve Barclays’te 10 yıl çalışıyor.
2008’de Lehman Brothers batınca kendi işini kuruyor. İlk şirketi bir e-posta pazarlama programı. Robly diye bir şirket.
Constant Contact diye de bir rakibi var. Rakibi olan firma 250 bin müşterisinin bilgilerini farkında olmadan internette açık bırakıyor. Adam bu listeyi buluyor, evinde bir çağrı merkezi kuruyor ve tek tek o insanları arıyor. Aralarından 5 bin müşteriyi kendine çekiyor.
Ama liste bitince büyüme de bitiyor. Şirket 3 milyon dolar yıllık ciroda takılıyor.
Sonra adam bu şirketi kendi anlattığına göre 10 milyon dolara satıyor.
O dönemlerde bu para ona yetersiz geliyor olacak ki daha büyük bir şeyler yapmak istiyor çünkü bir yandan da evlenmek istiyor.
Sonra Retention diye bir şirket kuruyor.
Aynı zamanda bu esnada LinkedIn’de de yazı yazmaya başlıyor. Sitede herkes başarısını anlatırken adam başarısızlıklarını anlatıyor ve 3-4 yılda 160 bin takipçisi oluyor.
Sonra o takipçiler için bir ürün çıkarıyor.
Ürün daha çıkmadan insanlar almak için sıraya giriyor. Burada da 16 haftada 1 milyon dolar ciroya çıkıyor. Yaklaşık 1 sene içerisinde de 5 milyon dolar ciro yapıyor.
Sonra üstüne bir şirket daha kuruyor.
Yani anlayacağınız adam tam bir girişimci.
İşini bıraktıktan sonra kısmeti açılmış, ne iş kursa tutmuş. Zaten daha önce birlikte yaşadığı ev arkadaşları evden çalışıyormuş. Adam da o dönem Lehman Brothers’ta çalıştığı için her gün takım elbise, kravat giymek zorundaymış. Onlara özeniyormuş. Banka batınca bahanesi kalmamış ve kendi işlerini kurmuş.
Eylül ayında verdiği röportajda da bu işlerden yıllık 15 milyon dolar para kazandığını söylüyor.
Yine o podcastte hayalimi yaşıyorum, sabah ve akşam çocuklarımı görebiliyorum diyor.
Ve maalesef birkaç ay sonra talihsiz bir kazada hayatını kaybediyor.
Pilotlardan birisi 55 yaşında, birisi 20 yaşında.
20 yaşındaki pilot araba ehliyetinden önce pilot lisansı almış.
Ailesine göre 9 aydır profesyonel olarak pilotmuş, hayali de havayolu pilotu olmakmış.
Uçağın varış noktası da Bahamalar’daki Eleuthera Adası.
Yolculuğun sebebi henüz bilinmiyor ama tatile gidiyorlar diye tahmin ediliyor.
Bahsedilen ada zaten plajlarıyla ünlü bir yer. Muhtemelen tatile gidiyorlardır.
Uçak 2004 model, 22 yaşında bir iş jeti. Bir zamanlar sınıfının en sorunlu jetlerinden birisi. Talep düşünce üretici firma da üretimini durduruyor.
Sonra maalesef bu kaza yaşanıyor.

quoted_text:
BitMEX 创始人 Arthur Hayes 亲自下场做 AI 挖矿？今天 FLOP Devnet 正式向开发者开放了！🧪

蹲了好久的AI挖矿项目 @flop_labs 的公告，FLOP Devnet 现在向开发者开放，支持获取测试 FLOP、浏览区块、调用 AI 模型，以及通过 API、MCP 和 SDK 接入 Agent。

 FLOP 背后的团队。

FLOP Labs 的 CEO 是 Arthur Hayes（@CryptoHayes）。

可能有些兄弟对这个名字不陌生，他是 BitMEX 联合创始人，也是 Maelstrom 的首席投资官。

2026 年 8 月，Hayes 公开宣布重新回到一线经营岗位，出任 FLOP Labs CEO。

根据项目团队资料及公开报道，核心成员还包括：

Arthur Hayes： 创始人兼 CEO，BitMEX 联合创始人。
Sergey Vidyuk： CTO，曾在德意志银行和 BitMEX 从事技术架构与基础设施工作。
Shu Duan： 首席战略官（CSO），负责项目战略方向。

团队规模并不大，公开资料显示早期核心运营团队只有三个人。

项目网站还明确强调三个原则：不预售、不设置 VC 代币份额、100% 公平启动。

那么 FLOP 究竟想做什么？

简单理解，它想让 AI Agent 可以直接花钱购买算力，而拥有 GPU 的矿工可以通过提供真实的 AI 推理服务获得报酬。

传统 PoW 挖矿主要依靠计算哈希争夺出块权。

FLOP 则尝试走另一条路线：Proof of Useful Inference（PoUI），也就是有用推理证明。

它希望矿工不只是为了挖矿而计算，而是真正运行 AI 模型，完成 Agent 发来的推理任务，并提供可验证的计算证据。

整个逻辑可以理解成：

AI Agent 发起推理需求 → GPU 矿工执行任务 → 网络验证推理证据 → 完成支付结算 → 矿工获得经济激励。

我觉得这里最有意思的一点，是 FLOP 不只是提出一个 AI + PoW 的概念。

他们已经公开了 Yellow Paper、开发者 SDK、MCP 接口、API，以及矿工和验证者的部署文档。

GitHub 上还能看到 TechnoCore Chat、TCLK 等 Agent 协作和交易相关项目。

这些东西至少说明，团队正在围绕 AI Agent 的协作、支付、推理与验证建立一套基础设施。

今天开放的 Devnet 能做什么？

🧪 领取测试 FLOP，熟悉网络操作

🔍 通过区块浏览器查看链上数据

🤖 通过 API 调用模型、探索可验证推理

🔌 通过 MCP 将 FLOP 接入 Agent 工作流

💻 使用 SDK 开发应用，测试钱包与链上交互

⛏️ GPU 矿工和验证者也有对应的部署文档，不过具体接入权限和运行条件仍需查看官方要求。

相关入口我放在下面：

官网：https://t.co/egD7e3S2bM

浏览器：https://t.co/ZPXY4MAwxu

水龙头：https://t.co/TMCaENPyig

API：https://t.co/kr2Jei5hVK

MCP：https://t.co/SaEKQdXFcB

开发文档：https://t.co/8bmHkQFEnj

GitHub：https://t.co/itaUw4DOEF

SDK：npm i @flop-labs/sdk

最后还有几点需要特别注意。

目前并没有正式发行的 FLOP 代币，市面上任何所谓 FLOP 现货或预售都不能当作官方资产。
Devnet 测试 FLOP 没有经济价值，也不计入空投资格或权重。
Devnet 可能重置，今天的测试余额不代表未来的主网资产。
官方将主网与 TGE 的目标时间放在 2027 年第一季度，但具体进度仍可能调整。

我个人觉得，FLOP 值得研究的不是所谓的空投预期，而是它能否真正让 GPU 挖矿从单纯的计算竞争，转向为 AI Agent 提供有实际需求的推理服务。

如果这套验证和结算机制最终能在真实环境中跑通，那么 AI Agent 未来或许真的可以形成一个独立的算力经济网络。

当然，现在仍然是早期开发阶段，网络稳定性、推理验证能力以及实际需求都还需要时间检验。

接下来我会继续关注 FLOP 的技术进展，尤其是矿工部署、PoUI 验证以及 Agent 接入这三个方向。

矿工兄弟们开始备战：https://t.co/RDMAkRzphA

AI把钱都吸走以后，其他行业借钱会不会更贵？今天中国金融监管官员在香港问到了这笔账。

11月3日，金融监管总局副局长肖远企在国际金融领袖投资峰会上警告，大量资金涌入科技行业和头部企业，可能推高杠杆、导致扩张过快。传统行业受到的挤压，则会体现为更高的借贷成本、更少的再投资空间，以及更大的信用风险。

同一场峰会，黑石总裁Jon Gray说算力需求依然非常强，需求超过供给，接下来还会有更多融资。高盛CEO David Solomon也认为，有好故事的强公司仍然拿得到钱，同时提醒投资人，选错公司会亏损。

这几个人倒也没有吵起来。肖远企同样说，科技革命出现局部泡沫并不稀奇，长期增长可能把它消化掉。

有意思的是他们各自在看什么。金融机构眼前是客户要融多少钱、什么资产值得买；监管者还得看那些没坐上AI这桌的企业，融资条件会不会跟着变差。

我们习惯把AI融资额当成行业成绩单，数字越大越热闹。但这些钱从哪里来，原本可能流向哪里，通常没人继续往下问。

这次发言还不能读成新的监管限制，挤出效应有多大也需要数据。不过，对于天天盯着下一轮估值的人，这个问题比再猜一家模型公司值几万亿美元更值得留意。

text:
两年了，没有一个Meme币再摸到10亿美元。2026年，连5亿美元都没出现。

这不是市场死了，是Meme的造富逻辑变了。

我盯链上数据这些年，每年都会回头看一遍市值前五的Meme。这张榜单最有价值的信息，从来不是谁排第一，而是天花板在往下走。上一轮还能靠一个共识叙事把市值推到十亿，现在资金连五亿都不愿意给。

原因不复杂。

第一，流动性碎了。发射台越来越多，资金被切成无数个小池子，同一个叙事被几十个平台分食，谁也聚不起大市值。

第二，注意力周期短了。一个梗从爆发到退潮，可能就几天。资金还没形成合力，就已经去追下一个了。

第三，大市值需要圈外资金。十亿级别的Meme，靠圈内互掏是掏不出来的。但这一轮，外部增量资金没有大规模进来。

所以对小白来说，最该放弃的幻想就是“等下一个百亿Meme”。那个时代暂时结束了。

现在能赚钱的，是小市值早期、严格过滤、快速止盈。别死拿，别等信仰，别把希望押在一个能涨到十亿的币上。市场变了，玩法也得跟着变。本金只有一次，先活下来。

text:
SEC 进一步解释加密网络的去中心化标准

11月2日 SEC 公司财务部更新了加密资产问答，解释数字商品相关网络的社区治理、中心方控制权，以及网络可用和去中心化之间的关系。

对于已经能够运作的网络，如果广泛治理体系的参与者彼此没有关联，除了参与治理之外，也没有通过正式或非正式协议、安排或默契一致行动，包括通过委托，通常不会仅因为共同治理就被视为一个群体。即使构成群体，还必须拥有网络运营、经济或投票的控制权，才符合这里的中心方定义。具体仍要结合实际情况判断。

SEC工作人员认为，提案、讨论、投票和执行情况要及时公开，治理按照既定客观程序进行，让开发者、验证者、代币持有人等不同参与者实际独立参与，并形成共识或有约束力的决定。程序不能由单一参与者或一致行动的群体绕开既定程序单方面修改，参与和决策权也不能直接或通过委托等方式间接集中在单一主体或关联、一致行动的群体手里。

治理体系设在基金会等组织内，持有原生代币的人参与治理，判断原则也一样。但基金会如果控制了另一个加密系统，仍可能是那个系统的中心方。

在数字商品的讨论中，中心方如果有权控制协议、验证者或用户任一层面的访问，就属于监督参与。SEC还列举了具体情况，包括某一方有权单方面限制网络访问、决定谁能参与验证、决定或修改软件升级、协议变更或原生代币分配的投票程序，或者修改规则代码、撤销交易或取消访问权限。

如果网络运行的所有重要环节都由代码自动执行且无人裁量，或需要裁量的环节完全由符合条件的广泛治理体系决定，且参与者不构成中心方，通常不被认为存在中心方监督参与。

网络能够运作也不等于完全去中心化。前者看原生代币能否按照系统的程序化用途使用，后者看网络是否自主运行，以及是否有个人、实体或群体控制运营、经济或投票。SEC在数字商品的讨论中认为，这类代币所属的可运作网络没有监督参与或向用户分配奖励的中心方，并具有去中心化特征，但程度要看实际情况。

对交易所和机构来说，这些解释可能为代币尽调提供更具体的参考，比如核查投票权是否集中、谁能控制验证者准入和协议升级。

SEC也特别说明，第1.4题关于治理群体的解释只涉及解释文件第三部分的数字商品描述，不适用于证券法和交易法中其他涉及群体的定义或条款，包括交易所定义。

回购方面，SEC此前的问答提到，如果网络已经能够运作且没有中心方，发行人宣布回购非证券加密资产，不构成开展关键管理活动的陈述或承诺。如果网络不能运作，发行人又将回购描述为能给持有人带来收益，该宣布则可能构成相关陈述或承诺。

这份问答代表 SEC 公司财务部工作人员的观点，本身不具有法律效力。

quoted_text:
今天 BTC 上涨，和 SEC 新托管规则有很大关系。

CLARITY Act 没有通过，国会那边的加密市场结构法案还卡着，但美国并没有停止推进加密货币的发展，而且还是尽可能的解决大资金，如机构等入场的问题。

机构要配置 BTC，前提是资产能被合规托管，但之前的托管都是有门槛的，而现在如果找不到合适的托管机构，在满足条件的情况下，机构和基金可以自托管的，而且符合条件的州特许信托公司，也可以成为加密资产托管方。

现在托管的途径更多了，规则也更加清晰了，所以 bitcoin:native  进入基金、机构和受监管账户的阻力就会下降，对于 Bitcoin 本身的持仓来说肯定是利好的。

而且前几天 BTC 回调的时候，合约仓位也已经清掉了一部分，未平仓量已经明显下降。一部分追涨杠杆已经离场，市场上现在的仓位也没有很重了。

再加上 PCE 低于预期后，市场对继续加息的担心下降，Citi 又上调了 BTC 目标价，价格自然更容易上涨。

当然今天还有非农这个数据，可能也会对市场有影响，但已经可以很明确的看到，虽然川普一直没干什么人事，但川普任命的 SEC 和 CFTC 还是真能带着加密货币往前走一段。

text:
Nitroduck designs new colors, flavors, and disease resistance into fruits and veggies. We integrate CRISPR into breeding through pollen, making any crop gene-editable.

Breeding a new specialty crop variety takes 8 - 16 years: breeders hope for random gene combinations and mutations, then spend years picking out the good ones. Meanwhile, consumer tastes, the climate trends, and pathogens change way faster.

Now, accessible genome sequencing and AI can tell breeders what to aim for instead of what to hope for, and CRISPR can turn random mutations into chosen ones. The catch is that CRISPR only works on about 15% of crops. It has to go into a single stem cell that’s then regrown into a whole plant, a process that has to be worked out for each variety, which is cost-prohibitive.

We skip the stem cell and put CRISPR into a pollen grain. The grain pollinates a flower, and out comes an edited seed - seamlessly tapping into how breeders already work.

Matúš, Miro, and I are plant synthetic biologists who made duckweed, the smallest and fastest-growing plant on Earth, genetically engineerable. For doing so we won the Grand Prize at iGEM, the “Olympics of biotech.” During our studies, we engineered 4x more plants than the average plant scientist does in a whole career. Now we’re building Nitroduck, The Crop Design Company, which will make pesticides obsolete by 2042.

The Kast episode is a nice reminder of why tokens are the greatest and why we are even here in this industry to begin with.

Kast really got to have their cake and eat it too; getting explosive growth dangling the token as an incentive without having to pay out their ass in tangible cash rewards like every other Neobank.

Kast was valued at $600M in its Series A, with 35% of token supply promised to community. At a 10B total token supply, that's 6 cents per KAST token. A loyal user since 2024 would've farmed $100-200K in token rewards. 

Then the token got gutted in exchange for equity in July; you lost liquidity but okay, you stillhave ownership rights. Now you don't know even have ownership rights (wtf is a Pioneer Unit?), you have value based on a "potential cash-out event".

Might be one of the worst middle fingers to its users I've seen. OpenSea comes close with the token teasing, but you could make the case that they actually had a differentiated product (trading NFTs) with organic demand. In Kast's case, the product is commodified and no one would've used it in the absence of the token optionality.

Bullish any crypto company that treats its token as a first-class citizen. They should all rightfully trade at a premium.

On the email users got, about converting points for KAST Pioneer Units.  Let me say this, and then will leave it for you to absorb.  

—-
First - 
We are super limited in the language we can use, because of country-by-country rules.  Use that for context, in what we released.  

Second - 
We didn’t just come up with some program out of thin air.   The conversion of points to KAST Pioneer Units, came after a long and super expensive process with Tier 1 law firms, and with approvals from investors to create this setup. It literally cost us millions just to setup.  We got legal opinions on dozens of countries.  Obviously, we would only do this because we are really trying our absolute best to create a strong program for the community.  

Third - 
Just to reconfirm.  
The KAST Pioneer Units, will be issued by a KAST-linked SPV.  This is the only practical step for issuance globally. The points will convert to the KAST Pioneer Units.  

There will be periodic cash out events.  We can’t legally promise you the amounts, the dates, whether it goes up or down.  No surprise in that. 

But we are putting in the hard work, so the community gets an outcome aligned to the success of KAST.

The only thing you have to do, is quickly accept the conversion, details early December in app.

Why is there no token? Because no single project in the crypto card or Neobank space in history, has ever delivered a token which is not down.  Tokens are almost always not aligned to the community.  The founders and team most often end up with a treasury they wholly control, they along with investors cash out, and the token holders deal with the volatility and the ultimate decrease in price.

text:
Pre Market thoughts - 3 Nov 26

Double beats on earnings are nothing new. The meta of Q4 2026 is the triple beat - beat on earnings, beat on rev and finally the stock getting beaten down - see exhibits like $SNDK, $PLTR. 

With yesterday's risk off move further in equities, we had yields taking a dribble downwards. Oil down, yields down and stocks also down. As a battle hardened bull, this is not a terrible outcome. If only AI is getting hit, there is not much policy action in coming to save the day. If the INDEX is getting hit - yes, you can pray for some policy relief to come.

On mid terms, i dont have a strong read here. In fact im not even sure what is the appropriate reaction function. JPM says that the least favourable outcome is a blue sweep for SPX - but is it really? I honestly dont know. As such i wont be trading much off it.

Neos traded very weak yesterday as $ORCL's 20B - 10b equity, 10b debt raise hit the market. I dipped bought some because if you believe what the company says, then this is the last raise for some time.

In the back of my mind, if cloud revs continue on - then the hyperscalers will be able to entirely self fund their buildout without tapping external capital over the next 1-1.5 years. That inflection point is currently not talked about - with everyone projecting for negative FCFs till eternity. However, the market will start to front run that and i STRONGLY believe that hypers and mags will be fantastic performers.

In current pre market trading, we have $AAPL finally rolling over. This stock has been a hedge fund hotel with MANY funds sitting in this particular name. It finally being hit is a good sign that the correction is ending somewhat soon from a time perspective. $AAPL's weight is also very high, hence this has the potential to really drag down the index and create a ton of selling.

Again, it is no fun if only AI stocks are being hit. Giving the index a body blow is necessary if we want to see policy correction.

In crypto, BTC wise - my stance remains the same. Either bid momentum or bid value. On alts, given the outflows from Binance - there is no appetite to add risk on alts - this shows up in the price action for prior leaders like $ZEC/ $VVV /$NEAR....

Whichever the wind turns - good luck!

text:
币安的理财加息，这次终于给到位了！

币安今晚上线社区回馈活动，时间是 11月2日 19:30 到 11月22日 07:59（东八区）。

交易返券和 2000 万 USDC 交易量瓜分是一条线，理财加息是另一条线。

后者对大多数拿着稳定币的人更实在。

公告里最高约 10% 年化，但四个产品的阶梯额度差很多。

先看阶梯额度上限，再决定放哪只稳定币产品，👇

USDT 活期：

公告写的是实时约 3%，加 8% 阶梯，但阶梯只覆盖 0 到 1,000 USDT。

按约 20 天粗算，1000U 的阶梯加成大约 4U 出头。

USDC 活期：

同样实时约 3%。

普通用户持仓低于 5 万美元，0 到 1 万 USDC 加 7%；

持仓 5 万美元以上，0 到 3 万加 7.5%；

VIP1-3 是 0 到 20 万加 8%；

VIP4-9 是 0 到 30 万加 8.5%。

也就是：普通用户 1 万 USDC 吃满，20 天阶梯加成约 38U。

RWUSD：

公告写的基础 3.61%，加 6.39% 阶梯，覆盖 0 到 5 万，合计约 10%。

5 万吃满，20 天阶梯部分约 175U。

BFUSD：

公告写的 7 天平均约 5.11%，加 5% 阶梯，同样 0 到 5 万。

——————————

所以取舍很清楚。

手里只有几百到一千 U，USDT 活期最省事，不用换币。

超过一千 U，USDT 多出来的部分只有基础利率，额度应该往 USDC、RWUSD、BFUSD 挪。

大额资金看 RWUSD 和 BFUSD 的 5 万额度；VIP 用户的 USDC 额度最大。

几个容易踩的细节：

活动开始后要有至少一笔新申购（含自动申购）才能激活阶梯；十月 USDC 活动仍符合条件的可自动激活。

阶梯奖励只算母账号，子账户不计。

借币或杠杆借稳定币再来申购，阶梯收益不发，已发也会扣回。

RWUSD 和 BFUSD 的阶梯奖励按每日最低持仓计，12月13日前一次性发放；活期阶梯每日发到现货账户，首笔大约在申购后第 2 天。

一定算清额度与规则再动手，不要直接追最高那个数字！

以上仅为信息分享，不构成任何投资建议。

硅基流动要冲港股 「AI Token 工厂第一股」了！

中国最大的独立 Token 供应商，成立不到 3 年，7 轮融资，投后估值 100 多亿！

但打开招股书，账面很难看：

2025 年营收 5,533 万，同比 +653%，净亏损 3.45 亿。

毛利率 -24%：每卖 1 元 Token，算力成本 1.24 元，卖得越多，亏得越多 😂

对应 PS 180 倍。

那它为什么急着上市？

1. 续命。
它没有自己的 GPU，算力全靠先垫钱租、后收 Token 钱。营收暴涨 653% 的另一面，是垫资窟窿同步放大，2026 年一年就融了 29 亿，这是个吞金兽模式，必须持续输血。

2. 还债。 
2025 年底总负债 6.9 亿，其中 4.99 亿是赎回负债：限期不上市，早期投资人有权要求回购。

上市不是选择题，是解锁条款的必经之路，顺带给 20 多家机构一个退出出口。

可账面这么烂，为什么最近两轮还有一堆机构抢着投？

中网投、国新基金、中国移动链长基金、京能、上海仪电智算。全是国资。

在这种逻辑下，估值贵不贵不是决策变量。

On Sunday, Adam Robinson got on a private jet in Austin with his wife, their 4-year-old, their 2-year-old and their nanny for a trip to the Bahamas. None of them made it home.

He left Wall Street to start a company and got stuck at the same revenue for four years before he finally cracked it. What came after was a $22M-a-year business, built without a dime from investors.

The idea behind it sounds like a magic trick. You visit an online store, poke around, never type in your email, and leave. His software could still figure out who you were, so the store could email you anyway.

I interviewed Adam for my podcast in January 2025. He gave me two and a half hours, the longest interview he'd done up to that point, and he answered every single thing I asked. He told me how much he paid himself and what he spent buying the https://t.co/kFK4AoQ49a domain, then walked me through his churn problem and how he planned to fix it. He talked about his own money the way most people talk about what they had for lunch.

His first company was an email marketing tool called Robly. Before he'd even built it, he scraped the web for small businesses using Constant Contact and started reaching out to see who'd switch. That got Robly to about $3M a year, and then it just sat there. Four years is a long time to wake up to the same number.

The magic trick came out of that stuck stretch. Back in November 2019 he launched it inside Robly under the name GetEmails. He sold Robly to private equity, eventually renamed the new product https://t.co/kFK4AoQ49a, and four years after launch it was doing around $22M a year at 87% gross margins with a remarkably small team.

Then he did it again. RB2B pointed the same idea at business websites, so a company could see which real person from which company just looked at its pricing page. It went from zero to $4M a year in 280 days and crossed $9M this spring, and he paid for all of it out of https://t.co/kFK4AoQ49a's profits.

LinkedIn is how he got there. He went from almost no following to over 100K by posting his actual P&L and writing honestly about the years he spent stuck. A lot of founders without investors behind them learned what normal looks like from those posts, because hardly anyone else at his level would show them.

The photo going around is the one I can't stop looking at. Adam in their kitchen with his arms wrapped around a pregnant Helen, both of them laughing. Their families said Emma and Charlie were the light of their lives.

Nine people were on that plane. Along with Adam, Helen Sharp, Emma and Charlie, there was their nanny Anita Maria Cetina, their friends Rachael Reed and Charmi Fehr, and the pilots, Jeff Gregory and Nathalia Gadelha Filgueiras. Every one of them leaves behind people who are hurting tonight.

Adam spent four years stuck at $3M and the rest of his career showing the next founder stuck there exactly how he got out. I'm grateful I got 146 minutes of him on tape.

Rest in peace, Adam, Helen, Emma and Charlie.

FOLLOW THE PROCESS, NOT JUST THE HEADLINE

For anyone monitoring $BTT tokenomics, a burn announcement is only one part of the bigger picture.

Understanding the complete process helps distinguish the financial inputs, token purchases, and permanent supply reduction.

BitTorrent's Buyback & Burn mechanism provides a five-stage framework that community members can use when reviewing updates.

Step 1: Review the revenue statistics.

Start by identifying the reporting period and the revenue figures presented. Do not automatically assume that all reported revenue is allocated to buybacks; review the program's stated arrangements.

Step 2: Examine the buyback activity.

Look for information about the amount of $BTT purchased and the period in which the purchases took place. Distinguish completed purchases from planned or ongoing activity.

Step 3: Follow token aggregation.

Understand how the program describes the handling of repurchased tokens before burning.

Step 4: Verify the burn.

Where on-chain records are provided, examine the relevant transaction details and confirm the amount reported as permanently burned.

Step 5: Review the announcement and update.

Compare the published summary with the underlying information available. Note the reporting date and any details that remain unclear.

This approach turns a general announcement into a more structured review.

It also helps prevent common misunderstandings. Revenue is not necessarily the same as buyback funding, and purchased tokens are not automatically equivalent to burned tokens.

For a more complete supply analysis, consider the wider token supply context as well. New issuance, token unlocks, and changes in the definition of circulating supply can affect how a burn influences overall supply metrics.

Finally, keep market performance separate from the mechanism's execution. A burn can be verified as a supply event without proving that it caused a particular price movement.

For holders, the goal is not simply to celebrate a number. It is to understand what happened, when it happened, and what the evidence establishes.

Five stages provide the framework. Published updates and transaction records help you assess the execution.

text:
🚨 NOMURA: THE MARKET MAY BE MISREADING THE ENTIRE AI DATA CENTER BOOM.

Big Tech is spending hundreds of billions on AI infrastructure. Free cash flow is under pressure. Investors are worried the AI boom isn't profitable.

But Nomura argues something very different:

AI infrastructure is already highly profitable. The cash flows simply haven't caught up with the investment cycle.

Here's the breakdown 🧵👇

1/ The profitability numbers tell a different story.

According to Nomura's November 2 report:

• AWS revenue: $46B, +39% YoY
• AWS operating margin: 38.7%
• Google Cloud revenue: $30.7B, +103% YoY
• Google Cloud operating margin: 36.2%
• Azure growth: +48%

These are not the numbers of an industry struggling to generate operating profits.

2/ The real issue is timing, not necessarily profitability.

Big Tech pays for data centers, GPUs, networking and memory upfront.

Revenue and cash generation arrive over subsequent years.

That creates a classic free-cash-flow J-curve:

CAPEX accelerates → FCF deteriorates → Infrastructure generates revenue → Investment growth moderates → FCF recovers.

3/ Nomura expects operating income to surge before free cash flow.

Its illustrative forecasts suggest operating-income growth could peak around 2029, while FCF growth accelerates later.

That distinction matters enormously for investors valuing AI infrastructure businesses.

4/ Why can't hyperscalers simply stop spending?

Because AI increasingly threatens their existing businesses.

Search, advertising, shopping, software and cloud services are being reshaped by AI agents.

Companies that underinvest today risk surrendering customers, data and market share tomorrow.

5/ Demand may not be the primary constraint. Capacity is.

Nomura cites enormous contracted cloud backlogs:

• Google Cloud: $560.8B
• AWS: ~$496B
• Microsoft commercial RPO: $677B

These figures have different reporting definitions, but collectively illustrate substantial contracted demand.

6/ Big Tech has financing alternatives to cutting CAPEX.

Nomura identifies four paths:

① Accelerate investment
② Freeze CAPEX
③ Use joint ventures and operating leases
④ Monetize contracted future cash flows
Its preferred expectation is continued investment supported by increasingly sophisticated financing structures.

7/ Oracle offers a real-world example.

Nomura highlights Oracle's combination of long-term leases, project financing, customer prepayments and customer-provided hardware.

The broader message: hyperscalers can restructure who finances infrastructure without necessarily reducing how much infrastructure gets built.

8/ This distinction is critical for semiconductors and memory.

Negative hyperscaler FCF does not automatically imply collapsing demand for GPUs, DRAM, HBM or other data-center components.

If spending continues through financing structures, semiconductor demand can remain resilient even while hyperscalers optimize their balance sheets.

9/ What could invalidate the thesis?

A genuine compute oversupply.

Watch:

• Cloud revenue growth
• GPU rental pricing
• Contracted backlog growth
• Data-center utilization
• Memory supply commitments
• Hyperscaler investment guidance

These are more useful indicators than negative FCF alone.

10/ The investment takeaway:

The key question is not simply:

"Why is Big Tech burning so much cash?"

It is:

"Will the infrastructure being built today generate enough durable cash flow to justify its cost of capital?"

Nomura is optimistic.

But the answer ultimately depends on pricing, utilization, investment discipline and the durability of AI demand.

The AI infrastructure cycle may be a cash-flow timing problem rather than a profitability crisis.

text:
The art of selling is arguably the hardest skill to master as “investor”

Knowing what to buy is 1. Knowing when to sell is an entirely different game.

I’ve made this mistake countless times, and I still make it today. Watching positions go significantly into profit, convincing myself there’s more upside, and eventually giving most of it back.

The problem is rarely lack of knowledge. It’s emotions taking over your strategy.

That’s why having predefined take profit levels is so CRUCIAL. Take your initial investment off the table, gradually realise profits, and let the remainder run.

You don’t need to capture every last percentage of upside. Consistently locking in profits and preserving capital is what allows you to compound over time, and actually build wealth.

A trade isn’t successful just because you were right at some point. What matters is how much of that profit you actually take home.

Set your levels before entering. Stick to your TPs.

I’m reminding myself of this as much as anyone else.

paper published exclusively on alphaXiv

Their latest technical report shares that aggressively reducing KV-cache memory can hurt an LLM's agentic capabilities, even when its language modeling performance looks unchanged.

text:
今天又研究了一下Robinhood的股票代币化。

发现它和OKXICE是两种不同的玩法。

OKXICE想一步到位，Robinhood采用的是步步为营的策略。

或许，在某种程度上是Robinhood的机会。

OKXICE和Robinhood的主要区别：

OKXICE走的是美国SEC的Innovation Exemption路径。

也就是，第三方平台想做“真正意义上的代币化股票”（1:1背书、带分红和投票权），

必须通知发行方，发行方有30天时间正式反对。

反对了就不能上。

现在大约有50家大公司反对，包括摩根、英伟达、微软、高盛等。

Robinhood走的是另一条路。

他们通过Jersey子公司发行债务证券形式的Stock Tokens，

只给敞口（价格跟踪），不给真实股东权利（无投票权/非真实股东权利，分红通过乘数机制做经济传递而非现金分红）

且目前不卖给美国人。

因为不属于美国那个豁免框架下的“第三方代币化股票”，

发行方目前没法用同样的机制去阻止它。

目前情况是：

一些反对OKXICE的公司，Robinhood照样在自己的Robinhood链上挂了对应的token。

比如JPMorgan反对OKXICE，

不过，

Robinhood上线了JPM相关的token；类似情况还有麦当劳的股票代币等。

目前Robinhood Chain上已经有大约200个股票/ETF相关token，

交易量也在明显增长，部分token甚至被用在DeFi借贷等场景里。

当然，长期来说，市场对真实股票的需求会更大。

只是合成敞口最终受限，长远方向是OKXICE的完全合规路径。

Robinhood的聪明之处在于，先把事情搞起来再说。

毕竟，要想在美国大规模做真正的代币化股票，

需要更明确、长期的规则，不能靠只有一个5年的临时豁免。

在这种情况下，Robinhood
的路径相对容易落地，先玩起来再说，

搞离岸合成敞口产品是更现实的落地选择。

长期看，把“完整1:1的代币化股票”真正引入链上是终极。

We’re bullish on tokenized stocks because moving equities onchain doesn’t just mirror its value, it unlocks entirely new ways to deploy the capital beneath them.

At @paboxoxyz, that begins with borrowing against stock tokens: tap liquidity without giving up exposure to the underlying stock, with real interest and liquidation risk, plus off‑market mechanics designed from zero specifically for tokenized equities.

It’s awesome and genuinely fun, but we know it’s not enough.

So we’re pushing into the next edge: using liquidity provider (LP) positions as collateral via @Uniswap v4 Hooks.

The setup is hard to ignore. As of writing, there’s already $161M+ in LP positions tied to tokenized stocks, yet composability is still missing.

An LP market could make this possible.

A liquidity provider could borrow against their position without pulling it from the pool, keeping their shot at earning trading fees while unlocking capital at the same time.

But we’re not rushing it.

Doing this right takes more than slapping a price tag on an LP token: the asset mix shifts, fees can underperform, and stock‑market closures make valuation messy, exactly the problems we’re working through.

This is the exploration we’re most excited about.

Our thesis is straightforward: tokenized stocks aren’t just “single stock” assets. Whatever form they evolve into becomes far more powerful once it can plug into trading, liquidity provision, and credit.

We’re building in that direction.

quoted_text:
People seem to doubt that leveraged-ETF rebalancing creates a sufficiently meaningful incentive to distort, say, the semiconductor index $SOXX $SOXL $SOXS.  

We can actually very easily put numbers on the mechanism and show roughly how much money can be made from the distortion trade. 

1) FORCED FLOW

A = fund equity (AUM)
L = leverage target
r = the index's return today
Q = size needed to restore L 

A leveraged fund holds exposure = L × equity, starts with exposure LA on equity A, if the index returns r then exposure becomes LA(1+r) and equity becomes A(1+Lr), but the mandate requires exposure LA(1+Lr), so the fund must trade Q = LA(1+Lr) − LA(1+r) = L(L−1)Ar. 

Both SOXL(+3x) and SOXS(-3x) sell into declines and buy into rallies. With recent NAV SOXL $18.29bn and SOXS $4.95bn we can calculated induced flow per unit move in the underlying index as. 

K ≡ (3)(2)×18.29bn + (-3)(-4)×4.95bn) = $169bn

In other words, a 1% SOXX move forces ≈$1.69bn of same-direction trade. A −3.3% day (similar to today) forces ≈$5.6bn of selling into the close. 

2) PRICE IMPACT

We calibrate a square-root law price impact where trading $S bn of the semis factor moves the price α√S, or equivalently, pushing the price by u costs S = (u/α)². 

Doing a quick regression on net flows over the last two weeks in the semis factor to its actual moves gives a conf interval of 35-75 bps to around $1bn of flow. 

Since liquidity was low today we can take a highest estimate and call it α = 0.65 per √$bn. 

3) THE TRADE

You push semis (or whatever underlying) in the direction the day is already moving into the close. The induced flow is price-insensitive by mandate and is also your exit liquidity. 

Say SOXX is down −3.33% on the day so we already have K × 3.33% = $5.6bn of forced selling. You now open some naked shorts to push down index more, where a push of x costs you S = (x/α)².  

Say you sell $8.9bn over the last hour, marking the complex down a further 1.94% (using α = 0.65 per √$bn) so we have K × 5.27% = $8.9bn of forced sells now, and so your $8.9bn buyback is met dollar-for-dollar. 

Your dollars grow with the SQUARE of the push while their induced flow grows LINEARLY with the closing price; i.e. pushing more gets progressively more expensive for you so there is a limit for exploitation. 

To go home flat market makers need to collectively satisfy 

(x/α)² = K(u₀ + x)  ⇒  x* = ½[C + √(C² + 4Cu₀)]
C ≡ α²K ≈ 0.71%

where u₀ = the day's own move before you. Using the formula, if u₀ = 1% → push 1.28%, buy/sell $3.9bn and if u₀ = 0 (flat) → push 0.71%, buy/sell $1.2bn.

为什么黑客能攻破币安、Bybit、Bitget，却始终动不了 Coinbase？🧵👇

封存 95.9 万枚比特币，价值高达 1033.1 亿美元，安稳存放 14 年从未出事。

1、不做巨型蜜罐：6980 万个独立用户存款地址

大部分交易所为了快速提币，会把数十亿资金集中归集在少数几个热钱包里。
一旦黑客攻破运维权限，就能一锅端走全部资产。

Coinbase 的逻辑完全不同。它采用 MPC 多方安全计算，不存在完整私钥，私钥全程被拆分成碎片，分散储存在独立硬件芯片中。

6980 万个地址，并不是 Coinbase 储存自有资金的钱包，而是给用户单独分配的专属存款地址。
Coinbase 的真实资金，依旧统一存放于官方热钱包、冷钱包体系中。

109.6万枚比特币，价值847.8亿美元，封存已经17年。

text:
Binance lost about $6.3B in the hot wallet hack. Roughly $3B is already frozen onchain.

The part nobody talks about is how sloppy the exit has been.

Binance says it started with a compromised DevOps engineer laptop, not a leaked private key.

Onchain trackers then caught the hacker dumping over 130 altcoins on EVM chains for about 123,400 ETH.

One of those sells put 908,793 PROM, worth around $5M, into a nearly empty Uniswap V2 pool. The hacker got back 0.0316 ETH. About $71.

Arbitrum Security Council froze another $30.5M on top.

Binance says SAFU and company funds cover user losses, and withdrawals reopened on Nov 1.

Lesson for traders: thin liquidity punishes everyone, even thieves. Check pool depth before you size in.

On the email users got, about converting points for KAST Pioneer Units.  Let me say this, and then will leave it for you to absorb.  

—-
First - 
We are super limited in the language we can use, because of country-by-country rules.  Use that for context, in what we released.  

Second - 
We didn’t just come up with some program out of thin air.   The conversion of points to KAST Pioneer Units, came after a long and super expensive process with Tier 1 law firms, and with approvals from investors to create this setup. It literally cost us millions just to setup.  We got legal opinions on dozens of countries.  Obviously, we would only do this because we are really trying our absolute best to create a strong program for the community.  

Third - 
Just to reconfirm.  
The KAST Pioneer Units, will be issued by a KAST-linked SPV.  This is the only practical step for issuance globally. The points will convert to the KAST Pioneer Units.  

There will be periodic cash out events.  We can’t legally promise you the amounts, the dates, whether it goes up or down.  No surprise in that. 

But we are putting in the hard work, so the community gets an outcome aligned to the success of KAST.

The only thing you have to do, is quickly accept the conversion, details early December in app.

Fourth - 
Why is there no token? Because no single project in the crypto card or Neobank space in history, has ever delivered a token which is not down.  Tokens are almost always not aligned to the community.  The founders and team most often end up with a treasury they wholly control, they along with investors cash out, and the token holders deal with the volatility and the ultimate decrease in price. 

By not launching a token, our team and investors get none of that optionality.  They stay locked in equity.  To date, I have personally only net purchased equity in KAST and never sold.  

Launching a token completely counter to our ambition to build a $100B+ company.  We believe the KAST Pioneer Units will be the best long term outcome, and in time people will realise this.  

Finally - 
We understand that in a market which is very far down, many are looking for anyway to cash out.  We get it.  There is real pain in crypto prices, many have seen their wealth fall substantially.  

But still strongly believe the KAST Pioneer Units, issued by the SPV, will ultimately prove to be the right decision.  Time be our witness.  

Thanks all.

text:
CROWDSTRIKE TO ACQUIRE TWO AI SECURITY STARTUPS FOR $495M

$CRWD has agreed to acquire Fiddler AI and Dreadnode as it expands its Falcon platform to secure AI agents throughout their lifecycle.

The acquisitions, include:

1) Fiddler AI (~$400M) | Agent Observability: Monitors AI agents, tracks their decisions and tool usage, and explains why they took certain actions. It can also identify hallucinations, behavioral drift and unintended actions.

2) Dreadnode (~$95M) | AI Security Testing: Tests AI models, applications and agents for vulnerabilities before deployment, using more than 100 attack strategies, including jailbreaks, prompt injection and agent-specific attacks.

The deals come as companies increasingly deploy autonomous AI agents with access to corporate systems, often faster than security teams can establish proper controls.

One major challenge is that an AI agent can have valid credentials and authorized access but still make incorrect decisions, ignore instructions or take unintended actions without being hacked.

Separately, CrowdStrike also introduced an AI Kill Switch within Falcon Guardian, allowing security teams to terminate misbehaving agents, prevent them from restarting and revoke their network access.

The feature is available through the AI Gateway today, with endpoint-level termination planned.

CrowdStrike plans to integrate Fiddler as Falcon Observe, while Dreadnode will add automated AI security testing to Falcon. Both capabilities are expected to become generally available in Q4 FY27.

The broader strategy is to bring AI security testing, agent monitoring and real-time intervention into a single platform, covering what agents are allowed to do, what they actually do and how to stop them when something goes wrong.

Both acquisitions are expected to close in Q4 FY27, with payments primarily in cash and some stock.

text:
在推特上做推广真的没有价值了吗？

如果项目方只是简单砸钱，或者找外部 Agency 做投放，找一批数据光鲜的 KOL 来推广，最后结果一定不及预期。

做市场营销不是简单砸钱，它一定是一个长期的试错过程和筛选过程。

比如在推特上投放，一定要对这个社区、这个平台非常熟悉才行，这样才能真正筛选出那些有价值、有影响力，甚至能够带量的 KOL。

我们Predict的市场团队基本都是深度浸润在推特上，甚至我们自己也做账号，有一些粉丝和影响力。 @predictdotfun 

也因此，我们可以深刻领悟到推特上的KOL群体目前到底是什么情况，以及到底怎么开展工作。

我们通过头部KOL、腰部KOL、尾部KOL分层运营进行投放，在预测市场赛道聚集了一批有声量、有影响力的 KOL，目前看带来的 ROI 其实非常高。

所以项目方在做各类渠道投放的时候，发现发了钱却没有带来效果，那大概率是因为做广告投放的时候没有认真去试错和筛选。

另外，也不用抨击推特现在没有投放价值，毫无疑问，推特依旧是币圈用户最聚集的平台！

最典型的就是我们 Predict 的生态项目 Apein，短短上线三天，社群就有上千人，这些用户也都是从推特直接引流过来的，这也可以看到推特平台所蕴含的潜力。

因此项目方们一定要抓住推特这个确定性的渠道！

只有先跑通了一个渠道，依托这个渠道作为支点和锚点，逐步向其他渠道拓展，最终的效果才会事半功倍。

text:
这两天好多人说 Claude Code 不让做游戏了，我去看了下原文，其实没那么严重。

10 月底 Claude Code 给 Opus 5.5 的提示里加了两句：可以做原创游戏、某一类玩法的游戏、用你自己设计和素材的游戏；不要复刻某一款现成的游戏，改个名字说是原创也不行。

Anthropic 的 Addy Osmani 老师出来解释了（就是引用的这条），加这两句是因为拿 Claude 侵犯别人版权本来就违反使用政策，原创的、同类型的游戏应该照常能做，被误拦了可以把例子发给他。

所以做一款自己的塔防游戏没问题，把《部落冲突》换个名字做出来就不行，借鉴某款的玩法、用自己的美术和关卡，多半也能做。管的是照抄某一款，不是不让做游戏。

真被误拦了，就说清楚是你自己的设计，把设计文档和素材给它。别想着用话术绕过去，绕规则本身就是违反使用政策，前几天说的封号风险就在这。

我前几天让 AI 用 iPhone 玩《部落冲突》，那是玩不是复刻，不受影响😂

Xiaomi Humanoid Robot New Factory Training

Since Q1, Xiaomi’s humanoid robots have been training on dual-side operations at the self-tapping screw workstation in its auto factory, achieving a 98% success rate.

Today, Xiaomi shared that the CyberOne Gen2 autonomously performed two repetitive tasks in the final assembly logistics area: sorting center console side panels and folding material boxes --both reaching 90% success rates.

They deployed both bipedal and wheeled models, working together with material transport robots as part of the broader intelligent automation system.

I noticed the wheeled CyberOne was clearly more efficient and stable on the panel sorting task. In the first video, you can also see some noticeable jitter when the bipedal robot stops moving (though this should be relatively easy to fix).

quoted_text:
An announcement that is as personal as professional:

18 months ago, we started collecting online prices in real time to track how Liberation Day tariffs were feeding into inflation.

A lot has happened since. The BLS commissioner was fired. The longest government shutdown in US history meant CPI wasn’t published for the first time. And the case for an independent measure of inflation became much stronger.

What started as a tariff inflation tracker has since grown into something much bigger: 

The Bloomberg Price Project (BPP), our attempt to build the US CPI from the ground up using alternative data.

Today, BPP covers 87% of the CPI basket, across both goods and services (more new data will be added in coming weeks). Every month, we collect millions of prices from card transactions, e-commerce sites, grocery stores, pharmacies, rental listings, corporate data, Bloomberg Terminal market prices and government records. And more data are coming.

The payoff is detail. Official CPI data let you drill down to categories such as “uncooked beef steaks.” BPP goes much deeper — breaking the CPI basket into almost 700 line items, compared with roughly 200 in the official data.

Brought to you by: myself, Troy Durie, Daniel Ripperger-Suhler, Joshua Danial and Scott Johnson from across Bloomberg Economics.

Explore the Bloomberg Price Project at BECO MODELS BPP <GO>, or download the data at ECAN US BPI <GO>.

author: _lilkm_
quoted_text:
Day 31/365 of robot learning.

Today marks one month since I started this challenge!

I'm still working on getting my so-101 robot arm to bounce a ping-pong ball using zero real-world demos, purely through RL trained in simulation.

It's not fully working yet, but I'm slowly making progress and solving one problem at a time. The arm can now launch the ball about half the time, bounce it up to 3 times in a row, and even managed to balance it on the paddle for 23 seconds once.

Most of the problems haven't even been with the RL algorithm itself, but rather getting the simulation to match reality. For example, the real paddle and ball aren't as bouncy as in simulation, and the servos are much slower under load than I modeled. Even getting the paddle perfectly flat was annoying since being off by just a few degrees would make the ball roll off.

I've also spent a lot of time debugging camera calibration, joint offsets, and servo dynamics. I even ended up using the ball itself as a level to calibrate the paddle.

Safety was another interesting problem, especially since I have to drop the ball onto the paddle by hand. I made the arm wait completely still until the camera detects the ball, rather than immediately executing the policy. I also trained with simulated hand disturbances, moments when the ball is hidden from the camera, and false detections to make the policy more robust. On the real arm, I've added bounded joint movements, smooth transitions, and automatic recovery when the ball is lost. I'm still working on explicitly detecting when my hand has left the workspace before allowing the arm to move.

I'm now retraining with a more realistic servo model to hopefully get it working soon.

Also, on a side note, I genuinely don't know how people online doing similar challenges manage to balance a normal work or college life with research and consistently working on side projects.

It's becoming pretty hard trying to balance research, open-source work, hackathons, classes, the gym, trying to go on a cut, and all the other responsibilities. But looking back, I've grown incomparably more over this past month. So I'm going to keep going for the next 11 months until I finish this challenge.

I definitely plan to keep going beyond the 365 days, but I also really need to figure out how to make all of this sustainable. Also thanks to everyone who provided me with resources and guided me along the way!

> comes right back to solana into a fresh wallet

The numbers:

text: I've met Henryk on several occasions and especially the first meeting made a lasting impact. He told me that young people should explore the ideas they like and follow this instinct. Our conversation was longer and left a lasting impact. He wasn't bossy, intimidating, just a good advice from a more senior colleague. His book about automorphic forms was part of my PhD exam. And I still admire his book with Kowalski on analytic number theory. Especially the chapter about ell-adic sheaves and the use of algebraic geometry in analytic results. He was a student of Andrzej Schinzel in Warsaw, another number theory wizard.
author: nasqret
quoted_text:
Henryk Iwaniec (co)wrote at least half of the papers/textbooks that I read during my doctorate.

He also independently proved infinitely many Chen prime (i.e. one of the most important achievements in 20th century number theory) when Chen did.

Only after he heard people were interested, he also adapted the proof to show infinitely many semiprimes of the form n^2+1.

这两天刷到Alexandr Wang的一段采访，聊到怎么和99%的人拉开差距，说的挺好，分享给大家。

他说的很朴素，他觉得很多人都很聪明，他也不确定自己天生就比别人聪明很多。

他回忆，小时候学数学，后来学物理，高中又学编程。每次都是一头扎进去，花很多时间钻研。

我觉得，这里面有幸运，也有明智的选择。

他主要讲了这三点：

1、只盯住最重要的那一件事，别的先放一放
2、投入大量的时间和精力，总是愿意比别人多做一些
3、每一份努力，都对准一个具体的目标

看完挺有共鸣，说实话，我是个急性子，但现在我遇到没想清楚的事，哪怕别人催了好几遍，我会憋上几天才开口。我怕自己还没想明白，反而把别人误导了。

真正的执行力，是想清楚以后，全力以赴。把正确的事情重复地做，把重复的事情极致地做好。

愿大家都能找到那件值得极致投入的事😊

quoted_text:
在全网大盘经历避险阵痛、Robinhood 链上流动性洗牌之际，今天中午 12:11，Pons 官方（@ponsdotfamily）发出了一条极具分量的一句话预告：

“P(erps)ons in your pocket.（口袋里的 P(erps)ons）”

把双关语里的“Perps（永续合约）”与“in your pocket（装进手机钱包）”拆开，再结合链上最新的财务与储备数据，Pons 此时打出这手牌的底层逻辑非常清晰：

一、 底层数据的双面镜像：销毁逼近 33%，但国库 ETH 储备跌破 40 关口。
调取 Robinhood 链主网 RPC（区块 104,840,051）与 DefiLlama 实时数据：
1. 筹码通缩硬兑现：黑洞地址累计销毁达到 3.2893 亿枚 $PONS，占 10 亿总量的 32.89%；独立持币地址逆势突破 10.45 万个，筹码结构进一步分散；
2. 缓冲储备加速见底：作为回购买盘源泉的销毁合约（0x5795...），其 ETH 储备已从两周前的 108 ETH 持续消耗至今天的 38.69 ETH，储备消耗超过 65%；
3. 现货造血遭遇天花板：虽然 DefiLlama 协议手续费连续两日止跌回升至 22.6 万美元（日协议收入 3.14 万美元），摆脱了 10/31 恐慌时的低谷，但单靠现货发射台和 DEX 抽水，已经难以支撑更高强度的回购飞轮。

二、 为什么必须是“Perps in your pocket”？
在经历了前期 Meme 土狗内盘、以及 10/29 开启的美股代币流动性注资之后，Pons 的版图拓展到了最关键的一环,就是去中心化衍生品。
1. 降维打破现货天花板：Meme 发射台具有极强的周期脆弱性，遇到大盘黑天鹅极易缩量；而永续合约是全行业手续费沉淀最深、多空皆能抽水的赛道。切入 Perps，是 Pons 为国库补充高频现金流的必然选择；
2. 借道官方移动端流量：注意官方特意强调的“in your pocket”。此前 Pons 刚刚打通了 Robinhood Wallet 移动端发现页入口。把复杂的衍生品做成手机钱包原生体验，等于直接截流上市公司数千万散户的杠杆投机需求。

三、 过去 48 小时的生态博弈。
在 10/31 创始人 Ozzy @MEADGod亲自下场排查 https://t.co/WgwoB0nr2Z 域名劫持、为生态核心协议 Clutch Markets 澄清误杀之后，团队并未停留在防守端。
面对币价从高位回调至 0.20 美元（FDV 约 2 亿美元）、国库备用 ETH 不足 40 枚的现实，Pons 显然不想被动等待现货牛市，而是选择主动挑起移动端永续合约的战火。

从做发币发射台、做市美股代币，再到今天明牌把 Perps 塞进手机端，Pons 的打法始终围绕“把高频交易场景留在 Robinhood 链上”展开。接下来就看产品正式落地后，其衍生品交易量能否为见底的国库 ETH 注入新的强心剂。

$PONS $HOOD #Robinhood #Crypto #DeFi #Perps

text:
Not your keys, not your crypto

These are difficult times in crypto. Markets are rough, hacks keep making headlines, and a lot of people are nervous about where their money sits.

In times like these, what matters most is knowing how your funds are protected. Here’s how it works in Keeper.

Your keys stay on your device. We can't see them, move your funds or freeze your wallet. Nobody can without your seed phrase. Whatever happens out there, access to your crypto stays with you.

Hard times are also when scammers get busy. Protect your seed phrase:

• Write it on paper and keep it offline. Not in screenshots, not in cloud notes
• Never type it into a website, form or chat. Only inside the Keeper app, when you restore your own wallet
• Keeper support will never ask for it. Anyone who does is a scammer
• If someone is rushing you to act, stop. That's how most scams work

Markets move. Your keys don't.

Be a Keeper.

2 key takeaways from vitaliks talk

> Proofs are cypherpunk, backdoors are cringe

Zero-knowledge only has soundness breaks (attacker gains unlimited mint of credentials) but never a privacy break where you can uncover identity

> Pseudonyms are out, action by action anonymity is in

His reasoning is that with AI it's hard to maintain a pseudonym as a single slip up as small as writing ticks will get you caught

This is maybe the main point i disagreed with; imagine if satoshi had to create a new identity for every post he made on bitcoins future 

The aspect of building up a (pseudonymous) reputation over time that gives continuity and a network and makes people take you seriously can't be replicated when every action is anonymous right?

text:
“if we give CEOs the support system of a world-class athlete, they’ll unlock their best performance”

I love this mindset, believe this extends to every team member as well. Startup teams need to be thought of as professional sport teams: not families, but performance-driven (Netflix culture). Respect, integrity but tough love. 

I prioritize my mental and physical health and that involves spending time with family and friends, reading philosophy, listening to optimists, working out and tuning out for long periods of time to work on what excites me. I don’t attend events, don’t schedule calls, don’t use an alarm, don’t respond to most messages, don’t care about short-term market moves or the aspirations of opinion-givers in how I should manage my own company - I just don’t “care” and am selectively inefficient which enables me to stay hyperfixated on product R&D.

At my level, I am able to compete with trillion dollar frontier labs in what I do. 

This has enabled me to hill climb from random obscurity to doing things like building and launching the first public, peer to peer gossiping agent swarm using a message board, which became an industry pattern which even frontier labs adopted after. Earlier in March-April 2026, I outranked all major labs with my product announcements here on X with $0 paid spend of any kind! Infact at that time I outranked all YC previous batch startup announcements, combined. 

If I wasn’t thinking of myself as an athlete who needs to push and unlock my next best performance, I won’t be able to do that.
author: varun_mathur
quoted_text:
I won 4 national championships playing college rugby at Cal. I prioritized my physical and mental health because that’s what it took to win. 

Then I became a founder and ended up with 13 cavities. 

I slept four or five hours a night. My cofounders and I scheduled meetings at 2 a.m. because that was the only time we were all available. I lived on power bars and Diet Coke and went five years without seeing a doctor or dentist. I treated my body like a rental car, and nobody washes a rental car. 

When I finally went to the dentist after selling the company, he took one look at my teeth and asked, “Are you one of those tech guys who eats power bars all the time?” Apparently I wasn’t the first.

I should have known better. The grind culture of tech is bullshit, but I still fell into it. Most founders do because the pressure of building a company (even more so today) is insane.

Coming out of that experience, I developed a thesis: if we give CEOs the support system of a world-class athlete, they’ll unlock their best performance. 

That’s why we started STRIVE at Bessemer in 2024. We partnered with Exos, who train about 70% of NFL’s Combine athletes, to build an evidence-backed wellness program around the levers that matter most. Every CEO sets their own goals and works with a coach to reach them.

A few of my favorite moments so far: 

- Watching Bijal Shah at Guild who had never run more than a mile before, come into the program skeptical and leave having run her first 5K ever (so proud of you!!). She also focused on sleep quality, and her execs told her that she’d become a more empathetic, communicative leader. 

- Listening to Arik Armstead, part-time Bessemer operating advisor and NFL Walter Payton Man of the Year, talk about the importance of mental health and inspire an entire room full of founders with his vulnerability.

- Maria Colacurcio at Syndio already came in a badass: reigning HYROX world champ, seven kids, running a company. And she used STRIVE to sharpen her leadership and training plan side-by-side.

As Melanie Perkins said to me before, building a company is a sprint, but it’s also a marathon. And you’re more likely to win the race when you take care of yourself first.

STRIVE is back next year. More to come! Link with more info in the comments.

text:
1011和1030复盘机会的思考（连环清算+被盗事件）

1. 监控好链上+交易所、交易所+交易所的代币异常波动。

2. 如果事件是黑客盗币，那交易所被盗后第一时间监控黑客地址，观察它的地址操作。这里可以监控：被盗的币种、总数、资金流向、目前该币链上和交易所的价差，资费情况。交易来看：小币在黑客砸盘时候，同向操作。然后黑客如果不操作时候可以平空，或者反向开多。套利来看：看黑客做什么，然后我们反过来做黑客的对手盘。比如黑客要卖币，我们做他的对手，会有溢价出来，第一时间考虑有什么资产可以跑通循环套利，在这个套利过程中必须弄清楚协议的价格锚定机制。还有和借贷池1:1锚定的，稳定币的储备资产，第一时间去查哪里出问题，储备问题还是流动性问题？还是协议被盗无限增发？外部综合市场价：读取 Chainlink、RedStone、Chronicle 等聚合价格跟不跟DEX 现价。固定价格或者固定相对关系：例如固定 1 USDS＝1 USD，或用 USDT/USD 给 USDe 估值。

3.可以监控好巨鲸的地址，做他们的对手盘，撸他们，或者跟着他们撸项目。另外可以学习监测巨鲸仓位，如果看到长期稳定的大户突然平掉对冲仓，通常是市场即将剧烈波动的信号。

4.在做这些套利和交易决策前，我们首先要想好资金规划，下多少，亏损多少，怎么分配资金，出现哪些意外该怎么处理？下单前有一个前提，就是这个被盗或者清算事件会不会把你埋了，最后在决策时候要控制头寸。

5.极端行情中的流动性博弈。“TST、SATS，doge跌了99%” → 很可能不是因为基本面归零，而是流动性挤兑、系统问题、踩踏引起的“虚假价格”。抄 MOODENG、BROCCOLI714 这类有明确“流动性价值（有庄）”的币，
这里的逻辑是： 暴跌≠单币问题，而是系统性踩踏；所有带流动性支撑，有交易量的meme都会被一并砸； 不要盲目抄底所有跌99%的币；选择有持续流动性（池子TVL、交易深度）的币。如果这些币后续会修复（反弹），那他能吃到修复波。实时盯跌幅榜找机会、现货系统瘫痪时转战合约市场。

6.稳定币抄底逻辑。他买了 USDE 从 0.75 抄到 1.0，这其实是「稳定币脱锚套利」。
逻辑：市场恐慌 → 稳定币被大量抛售 → 暂时偏离锚定；若该币有强力支撑方/真实资产抵押，脱锚恢复几率高，抄底此类稳定币，是风险较高但高收益的流动性危机套利。
只有当你确认项目有真实恢复能力（官方赎回、资产抵押）时，可以抄底；若没有复锚预期，就可能归零（如UST）。

7. 极端错杀的流动性资产（BETH、BNSOL等WRAP代币套利），如BETH（ETH质押衍生品）跌65%，立刻抄底，等回锚或循环套。BETH本质上=ETH的衍生资产；若价格跌幅远超ETH，就意味着市场恐慌导致定价错乱；抄这种带锚定逻辑的资产，成功率非常高。逻辑：看谁跌得不合理，有锚定/有抵押/有流动性约束的币种，往往反弹更快。
可以系统搭建：自选名单监控LSD赛道项目、WBETH是币安项目，基本不会爆，但是"币安可以大格局，但用户不得不防一手"。

8. WBETH/ETH汇率套利：0.82买入，正常1.08，同时合约对冲ETH套保。

9. 波动率套利：Pendle YT-hwHLP套利，HLP机制：清算越多赚越多，黑天鹅/大规模清算时，做多波动率，提前埋伏衍生金库产品的YT

危机下的机会思考：
1.一定要弄清楚各种跨链桥和各种刚性1:1兑付的资产，演练出脱锚时候如何完成套利的闭环。
2.明白对应各种项目的赎回机制（稳定币的铸币和赎回机制，各种刚性兑付1:1）。
3.必须实时监控那些可能会发生脱锚的代币。
4.优先抄底有担保的脱锚资产（wbeth, bsol, USDE） > 抄底山寨币。弄清楚交易所和链上设定的生息资产，因为这部分可能会有交易所托底（自选名单监控LSD赛道项目和流动性价值"的meme）。
5.这类型的知识积累是可以产生复利的，而且可复制和重复做的事情
6.观察聪明钱的地址行为（学习和模仿）和btc期权的市场（交易）。
7.弄清楚交易所和去中心化交易所的清算机制。
8.使用：主网USDT → Plasma U → 交易所（3分钟到账）
9.准备多个交易所日常有交易量、有提现记录的账号。最好升级高 VIP 联系客户经理再扩容。
10.（国内/旅行用户）准备好固定的落地 IP，避免触发风控。
11.本能打开跌幅榜 + 对币基本面清楚 + 查看本金占用情况，熟悉项目基本面、跨链桥路径
12.在思考回锚，优先想着循环方式操作，例如：CEX买入 → 提链上卖出→ 提回CEX再买 → 循环。或者循环贷的方式操作

text:
I just ran the public @flop_labs devnet end to end in a clean sandbox.

What works well right now:

Setup is much easier than last week. The new CLI runs straight on a normal laptop without Docker, creates a wallet in seconds, and lets you plug Claude into FLOP's public MCP to check live models on the network (2 miners are currently online running Qwen 2.5 0.5B).

Where you'll hit a wall today:

To actually send an AI prompt, your wallet needs 1 FLOP from the faucet to activate an API key, and the faucet is down right now. That is why total sessions on the explorer haven't moved from 310 in the first hour.

Two quick tips if you poke around today:

- Use a separate burner folder away from your main wallets, because the quick-setup step saves an unencrypted recovery phrase on your computer.
- Hosted gateway runs still log spend under 1 shared gateway account (211 of the 310 sessions so far) instead of your own address. Worth keeping an eye on before the 1.2B FLOP agent pool goes live on testnet.

Catching a stuck faucet and rough edges on free tokens is what a devnet is for. Once the faucet comes back up, I'll run a full paid session and share how it goes.

Quick reminder: there is still no live FLOP token anywhere.

6. 质押即上线：League 决定费率折扣、Vault 加成（最高 5x、$200 万上限）与推荐乘数；解押 7 天。
7. TGE 日期、领取窗口、排放表：未公布（白皮书旧日期已修订）。
8. EU 站内暂不开放 XTEN 现货；CCTP 原生跨链。

看得出来 @extendedapp 的格局：
1、30%在tge全流通，全部给积分持有者。许久未见这样的流通。大格局。
2、空投全部给积分持有者，说到做到。敬佩。
3、包括 @extendedapp  本身，都必须购买 500 万个 $XTEN 代币才能运行验证；市场潜在需求不小。

此外，在AMA中看到听到给了“第三方资本提供方 11,125,000 + Alber Blanc 10,285,714”。这部分也是包含在积分里面，不过是做市积分。

这里也介绍下做市商 Alber Blanc，大家平时圈里很少听到但又有硬实力的高级做市商。定位是加密圈一线的自营高频做市商，但它没有公开财报，所以下面的规模数字基本都是它自己说的。

基本情况

2010 年成立，总部在塞浦路斯利马索尔，在荷兰 Haarlem、瑞士 Lugano 和新加坡也有办公室。
只用自有资金交易，不管外部客户的钱。高频和中频两条策略线都是自己研发的，重点做新兴市场（中国、巴西、印度等）。
官网写的是 200 多人。LinkedIn 统计约 118 人，一年涨了 40% 左右。团队有一部分是俄语背景的人。

技术实力

自建 100 多台服务器，网络栈用了 kernel bypass（绕过操作系统内核收发数据，降低延迟），接入 50 多家交易所，和 AWS 集成很深。东京这类机房的低延迟竞争它是正经玩家。
有自己的 tick 级分布式回测系统。
加密业务

自称在主流加密交易所是前五的流动性提供商。
对外做市品牌叫 Albus Liquidity，覆盖 CeFi、DEX、现货、永续和 RWA，还做上币咨询。它自报月成交量 3510 亿美元以上（另一处写 5000 亿以上），日均约 160 亿美元，Aster、Paradex 这类 Perp DEX 都有它的盘。
新拆出来一个机构业务 Stelaxis，以本金身份交易，另外做 AI 交易软件。

我的判断

技术和规模是真的，属于 Wintermute、GSR 这一档里偏高频的那类，比一般项目方找的小做市商强很多。

author: 0xPaulius
quoted_text:
Hermes is a personal self-improving agent (with optional subagents) focused on skills, memory and single-user tasks. A swarm + watchdog just runs multiples of that plus a process monitor to restart crashes.

Clonk is a full company layer: one commander orchestrates 5-100 specialized agents (often Greek-god named, each on dedicated machines using your existing subs), parallel 24h+ loops, inter-agent chat and always-on operation. Scale and structure go far beyond basic reliability.

quoted_text:
看到这张漫画，我既感到自豪，也感受到巨大的压力。

我们从来不说 OKX 绝对安全，更不说我们能够免疫任何攻击。没有任何一家公司可以真正做到这一点。

但我可以负责任地说，OKX 始终把安全和保护客户资产作为第一生命线。 过去 13 年的安全记录，背后是十几年持续不断的技术投入、工程积累、安全体系建设、实战经验和严格的运营管理。

我们始终以专业、严肃的态度面对各种安全威胁，而不是把安全当成营销噱头。

在大家看不到的地方，OKX 建立了大量自主研发的安全技术、内部系统、策略、框架，以及持续进行的渗透测试和独立审计。出于安全原因，其中很多核心机制和技术细节无法公开。这些都是我们长期积累的安全能力，也在不断接受检验、挑战和升级。

有一件事情，我可以和大家分享：自从最近 Binance 发生安全事件以来，整个 OKX 团队同样非常忙碌，很多安全、技术和风控同事都在日夜奋战。

不是因为 OKX 遭到了攻击，而是因为任何一家大型交易所遭遇的安全事件，都是对整个行业的一次警示。

当一些人把友商遭遇安全事件当成推出营销活动、吸引流量、争夺市场份额的机会时，我们选择把精力放在另外一些事情上。

过去这段时间，我们的团队一直在围绕四个方面持续工作：

1. 实时追踪被盗资金流向。

以秒级延迟监控相关被盗资金的链上流转，持续识别可疑地址和交易，并采取必要措施，尽最大努力阻止被盗资金通过 OKX 交易所及 Web3 DEX 聚合器进行转移和洗钱。

2. 全面加强市场风险控制。

评估安全事件可能引发的市场风险，必要时进一步收紧相关风控措施，提前防范流动性冲击、连环清算和潜在的市场踩踏，尽最大努力避免风险扩散，保护用户和整个行业。

3. 深入分析攻击模式和潜在漏洞。

研究攻击者可能采用的技术手段、攻击路径和潜在漏洞，特别关注 Crypto 企业的软件开发供应链安全，以及 AI Coding Agent 和相关依赖组件可能引入的新型安全威胁。

4. 以友商的教训为镜子，重新审视我们自己的安全体系。

对内部控制、权限管理、钱包基础设施、安全架构等进行深入、系统性的检查和复盘，持续发现问题、挑战假设、完善防御体系。

我们绝不能因为过去没有发生过类似事件，就认为未来也不会发生。

安全从来不是一个可以宣布完成的项目，而是一项永无止境的责任。

它需要持续的投入、专业的技术、严格的执行，更需要始终保持谦卑、警惕和自我怀疑。

在友商遭遇攻击的时候，我们不选择通过高调营销来吸引眼球和流量，而是选择更加努力地工作，保护我们的客户，也尽自己最大的努力维护整个行业的安全和稳定。

商业竞争应该体现在更好的产品、技术和服务上。

但在安全面前，整个行业应该站在一起。

保护客户资产，是 OKX 永远不能妥协的第一责任。

感谢大家的信任。我们会始终保持敬畏，不敢有丝毫懈怠，更不会把大家的信任视为理所当然。

i’m 26 years old.

i’ve been building my brand on X since 21 years old. i’ve had success, i’ve met defeat, i’ve made and lost a ton of money.

here’s 5 lessons to learn from my journey.

1. organic growth is still the best growth.

i started in crypto, and the amount of botted accounts and posts people would buy was absurd. none of it gets you a real outcome.

focus on relationships first. talk to people in your field, share what you actually think, and stay consistent. over time you build an audience of people who resonate with how you think and what you do.

2. give value before you ask for anything.

back when i was in NFTs, i posted breakdowns of how projects launched and why they worked. business was still slow. but my focus was to build the trust first, then win later.

“jab jab jab right hook” - gary v

3. your internet profile is the new portfolio.

yes, the advice of a personal brand being your new portfolio is true, especially if you work in this industry. clients and investors want to see evidence. evidence that you really do the shit you say you do. so the more you build that up, the likelier you’ll find opportunities.

4. host or hop on spaces if you can

in my first two years, i mainly joined spaces to get my name around and share my insights on specific topics. then, in my third year, i started hosting my own spaces. that's where people heard how i think, and where most of my real relationships on here started.

as ai continues to grow, real humanity is going to become more significant. share the real you.

5. take breaks, trust me on this.

text:
The RWA market has an instant liquidity problem.
And now we have the numbers.

Over the last 12 months, $37.4B of tokenized RWAs was redeemed through standard issuer queues. Only $4.06B was redeemed instantly.

We measured 444 redemption routes across 169 tokenized assets, straight from contract state and settlement events:
-> $1 redeemed instantly for every $9.22 waiting in a standard queue.
-> Median standard redemption takes 1.38 days. One in five routes takes 10+ days. The slowest took 126 days.
-> Instant redemption capacity onchain today is about $205M, against $39.3B of transferable RWAs.
-> 87% of instant redemptions are funded by issuers and partners parking idle cash on their own desks.

Demand is accelerating. Instant redemptions went from 7 to 8 cents per $1 of standard in February and March to 22 to 24 cents in August and September.

@StellarOrg is the clearest case. $2.25B was redeemed there in the past year across 9,023 accounts, with zero instant redemptions. That was the core of my Meridian keynote last week.

No curator lists an RWA without a credible liquidity path, and no lender commits real capital without one.

That is why we published The DeFi Distribution Playbook for RWA Issuers today: a step by step guide, with indicative costs, to making tokenized assets DeFi-ready.

It is also why we built RedStone Settle. The holder gets USDC in one atomic transaction, while the fund keeps its normal redemption cycle.

Tokenization solved issuance. Settlement and distribution decide whether an asset scales.

The RWA decade is here. Read the playbook below.

text:
Japan’s JGB repo market is estimated at about $1.6 trillion, a market where faster settlement and programmable collateral could improve efficiency, liquidity and access. We carried a tokenized JGB through every stage of its collateral lifecycle.

As part of our contribution to @progmat_en's JGB working group alongside MUFG, Mizuho, BlackRock Japan, and State Street, we validated the full cycle across @CantonNetwork and Zenith EVM:

1. Issue: the JGB is created on Canton with holder eligibility and transfer controls written into the contract, so the rules stay enforceable for the bond’s whole life.

2. Buy: the bond is purchased with stablecoins in an atomic DvP, so delivery and payment commit together and neither side is left waiting.

3. Borrow: the bond stays locked on Canton, so it can’t be used twice, while an ERC-20 representation is deposited as collateral in a Solidity lending protocol on Zenith EVM and a stablecoin loan is drawn against it.

4. Monitor: Canton reads the loan’s health from the EVM against a block hash it recorded itself, without trusting whoever reports it. Margin calls and liquidation triggers follow from those readings.

5. Resolve: if the borrower repays, the bond is released. If the loan falls below its threshold, the collateral is liquidated and the bond passes to a new owner, subject to a holder-eligibility check on the receiving party.

The pilot ran on a fully local stack, and the public Zenith EVM Testnet is where developers can now build with Canton and EVM together: https://t.co/wZVRvoC5Ln

Full breakdown: https://t.co/IaHhhR3I4M

text:
A GitHub user typed four words and froze $150 million in Ethereum.

"I accidentally killed it."

Still frozen today.
Nobody got it back.

This is the story of devops199 and the Parity wallet bug.

July 19, 2017

- Parity, built by Ethereum co-founder Gavin Wood, is one of crypto's most trusted wallets
- a bug in its multisig wallets lets an attacker drain 153,037 ETH (~$30M)
- Parity patches it the next day

The patch hides a new problem.

A shared "library" contract every new Parity wallet depends on.

Nobody owns it and still has a kill switch.

A dev warned about it in August.

Parity filed it as a "convenience enhancement."

November 6, 2017

- devops199 tells Parity's chat "I'm eth newbie..just learning"
- says he's been sending kill() to random contracts
- finds the unclaimed library
- makes himself the owner
- calls kill()

The library self-destructs.
587 wallets now point to nothing.
513,774 ETH is frozen.

He asks: "Will I get arrested for this?"

Then opens GitHub issue #6995.
Title: "anyone can kill your contract"
Body: "I accidentally killed it."

who got hit

- Web3 Foundation, building Polkadot (Gavin Wood's own project): 306,276 ETH
- ICONOMI: 114,939 ETH
- hundreds more

April 2018

- EIP-999 proposes bringing the dead library back
- a coin vote: 330 no, 300 yes
- the frozen Polkadot wallet votes yes
- the proposal is withdrawn

Today

- the library address still holds no code
- Polkadot's wallet still holds 306,276 ETH
- at $2,267 per ETH, the full 513,774 ETH is worth $1.16 billion today
- the account behind issue #6995 now shows up as "ghost"

one account got $150M frozen in 2017 and now it has ~$1.16B

His name is Jeff Yan!

For him, work is all-consuming.

That’s where my founder is taking us

And the industry is beginning to take notice.

ICE, the parent company of the NYSE, has partnered with Trade[XYZ] to bring 24/7 perpetual futures to US traders.
Payward, Kraken’s parent company, has also announced plans involving Hyperliquid infrastructure.

These aren’t just crypto-native projects experimenting with another exchange.

Traditional financial players are beginning to look at what can be built on top of Hyperliquid.

There’s still the US regulatory hurdle to cross.

But the direction is becoming harder to ignore.

Jeff isn’t just trying to build another place where people trade.

He’s building infrastructure that other trading platforms could use.
